title: OBR lost cities
description: Openworld BattleRoyale Datapack: Enable The Lost Cities to support Custom BattleRoyale
body:
This data pack is custom-made for Openworld BattleRoyale modpack.

## Key Modifications
- Overwrites only the standard assets from The Lost Cities
- Replace chests in buildings with Custom BattleRoyale loot spawners (ConfigId:0) and increase their quantity
- Replace mob spawners in buildings with entity spawner (ConfigId:1)
- Add entity spawner (ConfigId:0) to fountains and other locations
- Replace crafting table, furnace, and other blocks in buildings with workbench from the CBRG gun pack
- Add more colors of terracotta and glass
